series.title: Volume with a swipe
series.sub: The round button: swipe it, tap it, move it

chapters.title: Tap it, hold it, move it

steps.title: Meet the round button
steps.text: In the Simple style, a small round button sits on the edge of your screen, on top of every app.

steps.title: Swipe up on it
steps.text: Each bit you swipe turns the volume up a step. The level shows on the button, and Android’s volume slider comes up beside it.

steps.title: Swipe down to turn it down
steps.text: Swipe the other way and it steps back down just as quickly.

steps.title: Tap it for the volume slider
steps.text: A tap brings up Android’s own volume slider, ready to drag.
steps.chapter: Tap it, hold it, move it

steps.title: Hold it to pick it up
steps.text: Keep your finger on it until it dims and shows arrows. The long-press menu opens too, and steps aside as soon as you move.
steps.chapter: Tap it, hold it, move it

steps.title: Drag it anywhere, then let go
steps.text: Up or down the edge, or across to the other side. Let go and it settles on the nearer edge.
